description: One postgres commit (code-history index): message, trailers (names only), Discussion threads, back-patch siblings, first_releases (per branch: sha, release such as 14.23 or null, first_version, shipped), reverted_by, reverts, posted_patch (the Discussion patch mail matching it best, score 0-1, or null), files with line counts, and the diff (max 3000 lines; diff_complete).
